api_base.description: The EnkryptAI API base URL. Defaults to https://api.enkryptai.com. Also checks if the ENKRYPTAI_API_KEY env var is set.

api_key.description: The EnkryptAI API key. Reads from ENKRYPTAI_API_KEY env var if None.

block_on_violation.description: Whether to block requests when violations are detected. Defaults to True.

deployment_name.description: The EnkryptAI deployment name to use. Sent via X-Enkrypt-Deployment header.

detectors.description: Dictionary of detector configurations (e.g., {'nsfw': {'enabled': True}, 'toxicity': {'enabled': True}}).

policy_name.description: The EnkryptAI policy name to use. Sent via x-enkrypt-policy header.
